test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
What would be the word on the opposite side of 'Blue' if the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/688baa49836a4026f2b94567a811b5a587750d68c73edb391a7c60f77f21ed07.png]
solution: Opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below methods: - • Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other. • No two opposite surface are touched by side or by corners. So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.
